import MilneLib.SymmetricPower.SymmetricPowerQuotient
import MilneLib.SymmetricPower.RelativePowerOpenImmersion
import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotientCanonical
import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotientOpen
import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotientAffine

/-!
# Open subsets of symmetric powers

The image of a relative power map is invariant under permutation of the
factors. This is the source open used to construct the open symmetric powers
in Milne III.3, Proposition 3.1.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib

variable {S : Scheme.{u}} {V W : Over S}

/-- Permuting the target factors preserves the image of a relative power map. -/
theorem permute_mem_range_relativePowerMap (f : V ⟶ W) (n : ℕ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : (relativePower W n).left) :
    (permute W n σ).left x ∈ Set.range (relativePowerMap f n).left ↔
      x ∈ Set.range (relativePowerMap f n).left := by
  have hcomm (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (y : (relativePower V n).left) :
      (relativePowerMap f n).left ((permute V n τ).left y) =
        (permute W n τ).left ((relativePowerMap f n).left y) :=
    (congrArg (fun t : relativePower V n ⟶ relativePower W n => t.left y)
      (relativePowerMap_perm_naturality f n τ)).symm
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    refine ⟨(permute V n σ⁻¹).left y, ?_⟩
    rw [hcomm, hy]
    change ((permute W n σ ≫ permute W n σ⁻¹).left) x = x
    rw [permute_comp, mul_inv_cancel, permute_one]
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(permute V n σ).left y, hcomm σ y⟩

/-- The open relative power associated with an open immersion. -/
noncomputable def relativePowerMapOpen (f : V ⟶ W) (n : ℕ)
    [IsOpenImmersion f.left] : (relativePower W n).left.Opens := by
  letI := relativePowerMap_isOpenImmersion f n
  exact (relativePowerMap f n).left.opensRange

@[simp]
theorem relativePowerMapOpen_coe (f : V ⟶ W) (n : ℕ) [IsOpenImmersion f.left] :
    (relativePowerMapOpen f n : Set (relativePower W n).left) =
      Set.range (relativePowerMap f n).left := rfl

/-- The relative power of an affine open over an affine base is affine. -/
theorem relativePowerMapOpen_isAffine (f : V ⟶ W) (n : ℕ)
    [IsOpenImmersion f.left] [IsAffine S] [IsAffine V.left] :
    IsAffineOpen (relativePowerMapOpen f n) := by
  letI := relativePowerMap_isOpenImmersion f n
  letI := relativePower_isAffine V n
  exact isAffineOpen_opensRange (relativePowerMap f n).left

namespace SymmetricPowerData

/-- If the source symmetrisation is surjective, the induced map has the image
of the original relative power map in the target quotient. -/
theorem range_map {n : ℕ} (DV : SymmetricPowerData V n)
    (DW : SymmetricPowerData W n) (f : V ⟶ W)
    (hV : Function.Surjective DV.projection.left) :
    Set.range (DV.map DW f).left =
      DW.projection.left '' Set.range (relativePowerMap f n).left := by
  have hcomp := congrArg (fun t => t.left) (DV.projection_comp_map DW f)
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hV z
    exact ⟨(relativePowerMap f n).left x, ⟨x, rfl⟩,
      (congrArg (fun t => t x) hcomp).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨DV.projection.left x, congrArg (fun t => t x) hcomp⟩

end SymmetricPowerData

section Quotient

variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
  (V : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (n : ℕ)
  [(relativePower V n).left.IsSeparated] [CompactSpace (relativePower V n).left]
  (h : StableGroupAction.OrbitsInAffineOpen (permutationAutHomOverLeft V n))

/-- The canonical symmetric projection has orbit fibres and the invariant
structure sheaf on every open. -/
theorem symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient :
    StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient (quotientPermutationAction V n)
      (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection V n h).left :=
  StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen.finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient
      (quotientPermutationAction V n) (relativePower V n).hom
      (quotientPermutationAction_comp_base V n) (quotientPermutationAction_orbits V n h)

end Quotient

section OpenImmersion

variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
  {V W : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
  (f : V ⟶ W) (n : ℕ) [IsOpenImmersion f.left]

/-- The relative-power open is stable under the quotient permutation action. -/
theorem relativePowerMapOpen_isStable :
    StableGroupAction.IsStableOpen (quotientPermutationAction W n)
      (relativePowerMapOpen f n) := by
  intro σ
  ext x
  change (permute W n σ.down⁻¹).left x ∈ Set.range (relativePowerMap f n).left ↔
    x ∈ Set.range (relativePowerMap f n).left
  exact permute_mem_range_relativePowerMap f n σ.down⁻¹ x

variable [(relativePower W n).left.IsSeparated] [CompactSpace (relativePower W n).left]
  (h : StableGroupAction.OrbitsInAffineOpen (permutationAutHomOverLeft W n))

/-- The open of the symmetric quotient induced by an open immersion. -/
noncomputable def symmetricPowerQuotientOpen :
    (symmetricPowerQuotient W n h).left.Opens :=
  (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient W n h).quotientOpen
    (relativePowerMapOpen f n) (relativePowerMapOpen_isStable f n)

@[simp]
theorem symmetricPowerQuotientOpen_coe :
    (symmetricPowerQuotientOpen f n h : Set (symmetricPowerQuotient W n h).left) =
      (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection W n h).left ''
        Set.range (relativePowerMap f n).left := rfl

/-- The symmetric open is the image of the induced map from any source
symmetrisation with surjective projection. -/
theorem symmetricPowerQuotientOpen_eq_range_map (DV : SymmetricPowerData V n)
    (hV : Function.Surjective DV.projection.left) :
    (symmetricPowerQuotientOpen f n h : Set (symmetricPowerQuotient W n h).left) =
      Set.range (DV.map (symmetricPowerDataOfOrbits W n h) f).left :=
  (DV.range_map (symmetricPowerDataOfOrbits W n h) f hV).symm

/-- The preimage of the symmetric open is exactly the original relative-power open. -/
@[simp]
theorem symmetricPowerQuotientOpen_preimage :
    (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection W n h).left ⁻¹ᵁ symmetricPowerQuotientOpen f n h =
      relativePowerMapOpen f n :=
  (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient W n h).preimage_quotientOpen
    (relativePowerMapOpen f n) (relativePowerMapOpen_isStable f n)

/-- An affine open of the source gives an affine open of the symmetric quotient. -/
theorem symmetricPowerQuotientOpen_isAffine [IsAffine V.left] :
    IsAffineOpen (symmetricPowerQuotientOpen f n h) :=
  (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient W n h).isAffineOpen_quotientOpen
    (relativePower W n).hom (quotientPermutationAction_comp_base W n)
    (relativePowerMapOpen f n) (relativePowerMapOpen_isStable f n)
    (relativePowerMapOpen_isAffine f n)

/-- Sections on the symmetric open are the permutation-invariant sections on
the relative-power open. -/
noncomputable def symmetricPowerQuotientOpenSectionsEquiv :
    letI := StableGroupAction.sectionsMulSemiringAction (quotientPermutationAction W n)
      (relativePowerMapOpen_isStable f n)
    Γ((symmetricPowerQuotient W n h).left, symmetricPowerQuotientOpen f n h) ≃+*
      FixedPoints.subring Γ((relativePower W n).left, relativePowerMapOpen f n)
        (ULift.{u} (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))) :=
  (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient W n h).quotientOpenSectionsEquiv
    (relativePowerMapOpen f n) (relativePowerMapOpen_isStable f n)

end OpenImmersion

end MilneLib
